The affix यञ् comes in the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the word वतण्ड when meaning a descendant of अङ्गिरस।

Terms:

There is optionally लुक् elision of the affix denoting 'born therin' after the words 1. वत्सशाला 2. अभिजित् 3. अश्वयुक् and 4. शतभित्।

Terms: लुक्
The affix कन् coming after a Numeral ending with वत्, takes optionally the augment इद् , the sense of the affix being those given up to
The affix छ comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) in the five-fold senses taught in पन्थो ण नित्यम्

, after a stem ending in वत्सर।

Terms: छ

When follows is the augment of a stem ending in वतु।

Terms: डट् and (इथुक्)

The affix लच् comes in the senses of 'love' and 'strength' respectively after the words वत्स and अंस।

Terms: लच्

The augment कुक् comes before इनि (इन्) after the words 1. वात and 2. अतिसार।

Terms: कुक्

The affix ष्टरच् expresses slenderness after the words 1. वत्स 2. उक्षन् 3. अश्व and 4. ऋषव।

Terms: ष्टरच्
